subject: youtube.channel.city_2099
summary: «مدينة 2099» is a serialized Arabic sci-fi microdrama/IP bet set in one future city with recurring characters, using Shorts for episodes and long-form compilations for story arcs.

details.audience: Arabic 15–30 interested in anime, games, science fiction and short-form drama
details.narrative: each Short = abnormal situation -> character goal -> decision/paradox -> result + light cliffhanger; every 6–8 episodes form an arc
details.visual_direction: Neo-Arab futurism; purple/cyan; modern Arab architecture without clichés; Arabic signage; markets, trains, rooftops, night light; stable character silhouette/wardrobe
pilot: Short 45s: the last store that accepts cash
Short 60s: an ID card that knows you lied
4–5 min compilation: first three episodes + linking scene
